decisive_items: an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a high-signal bend in the same region
response.rationale: The acute presentation and imaging findings are characteristic of an atypical femoral fracture in a patient with prolonged denosumab use. Osteoporosis is the underlying background condition but does not explain the specific incomplete lateral cortical transverse fracture pattern.

rejected.why: Osteoporosis is a predisposing/background diagnosis supported by BMD and denosumab history, but it is not the most likely acute diagnosis for the presenting femoral neck fracture.
